name: FCX vs NEM Pairs Trade: Cointegration & Mean Reversion
description: Engle-Granger cointegration analysis of FCX (Freeport-McMoRan) vs NEM (Newmont). Rolling 252-day hedge ratio and spread with z-score signals at ±2.0 entry / ±0.5 exit. Dashboard shows: spread z-score with regime bands, event markers at z-score extremes, scatter of z-score vs forward 21d spread change, and summary stats (N, median reversion, hit rate).
source:
# FCX vs NEM Pairs Trade — Engle-Granger Cointegration & Mean Reversion
# Rolling 252d cointegration, z-score ±2.0 entry / ±0.5 exit
# Anchored to FCX; NEM loaded via reference_stocks

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
fcx_close = src.c

nem = reference_stocks(ticker='NEM')()
nem_close = ffill(nem.c)

ts = index().value

# --- Cointegration (Engle-Granger, rolling 252d) ---
eg = engle_granger(window=252)(fcx_close, nem_close)
spread = eg.spread
hedge_ratio = eg.hedge_ratio
is_coint = eg.is_cointegrated

# --- Z-Score of Spread (60d lookback for signal generation) ---
z = zscore(window=60)(spread)

# --- Mean reversion speed ---
hl = half_life_ar1(window=252)(spread)
half_life = hl.half_life

# --- Rolling ADF for spread stationarity ---
adf = rolling_adf(window=252)(spread)
adf_pval = adf.p_value

# --- Signal Detection: Z-score extremes ---
# Long spread (buy FCX / sell NEM) when z crosses below -2.0
# Short spread (sell FCX / buy NEM) when z crosses above +2.0
# crossunder is a two-stage transform; crossover implemented manually via lag
long_entry = crossunder()(z, -2.0)
short_entry = (z >> 1) <= 2.0 and z > 2.0

# Forward spread change at signal bars (21d ahead)
# Use << operator, NOT forward_returns — spread is not a price series (S46)
fwd_spread_21d = (spread << 21) - spread
fwd_spread_5d = (spread << 5) - spread

# Forward z-score to check mean reversion
fwd_z_21d = z << 21

# --- Metrics at signal bars ---
# Long signals: z < -2, expect spread to INCREASE (positive change = profit)
long_fwd_21d = where(long_entry, fwd_spread_21d)
long_fwd_5d = where(long_entry, fwd_spread_5d)

# Short signals: z > +2, expect spread to DECREASE (negative change = profit)
short_fwd_21d = where(short_entry, fwd_spread_21d)
short_fwd_5d = where(short_entry, fwd_spread_5d)

# Hit rate: did the spread move in the profitable direction within 21d?
# Long: positive fwd change = win. Short: negative fwd change = win.
long_win = where(long_entry, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_spread_21d) and fwd_spread_21d > 0) else 0.0)
short_win = where(short_entry, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_spread_21d) and fwd_spread_21d < 0) else 0.0)

# Half-life at signal bars
long_hl = where(long_entry, half_life)
short_hl = where(short_entry, half_life)

# Z-score at signal bars (for scatter x-axis and event markers)
long_z = where(long_entry, z)
short_z = where(short_entry, z)

# Hedge ratio at signal bars (for event markers)
long_hedge = where(long_entry, hedge_ratio)
short_hedge = where(short_entry, hedge_ratio)

# --- OUTPUT 1: Spread Z-Score Time Series (CONTEXT) ---
xy_lines(
    title='Does the FCX/NEM Spread Mean-Revert from Extremes?',
    category='Pairs Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score',
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Spread Z-Score', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Short Entry (+2σ)'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Long Entry (-2σ)'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Fair Value')
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-0.5, to=0.5, color=Color.Gray, opacity=0.1, label='Exit Zone')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=z)

# --- OUTPUT 2: Event Markers at Z-Score Extremes ---
# Long spread entries (z crosses below -2, cointegrated)
is_long_signal = long_entry and is_coint

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Long Spread Entry',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hedge Ratio', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Half-Life (days)', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(long_z, long_hedge, long_hl, is_long_signal)

# Short spread entries (z crosses above +2, cointegrated)
is_short_signal = short_entry and is_coint

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Short Spread Entry',
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hedge Ratio', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Half-Life (days)', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(short_z, short_hedge, short_hl, is_short_signal)

# --- OUTPUT 3: Scatter — Z-Score at Entry vs 21d Forward Spread Change (PUNCHLINE) ---
xy_scatter(
    title='Do Extreme Z-Scores Predict Spread Reversion?',
    category='Pairs Analysis',
    x_axis_label='Z-Score at Entry',
    y_axis_label='21d Forward Spread Change ($)',
    x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Long Entry (z < -2)', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker),
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Short Entry (z > +2)', color=Color.Red, marker=MarkerSymbol.TriangleDownMarker)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='No Change')
    ]),
    show_trend_line=True,
    order=2
)(x=z, y_values=(long_fwd_21d, short_fwd_21d))

# --- OUTPUT 4: Summary Stats Table (REFERENCE) ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Pairs Analysis',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Mean Reversion Stats (21d Forward)',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Events (N)', 'Median 21d Spread Chg ($)', 'Hit Rate (21d)', 'Median Half-Life (days)'],
        col_headers=['Long (z < -2)', 'Short (z > +2)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(long_fwd_21d, short_fwd_21d, long_fwd_21d, short_fwd_21d, long_win, short_win, long_hl, short_hl)
